svg.title: Autoregressive document queue forecast and MAE comparison
svg.desc: A two-panel chart. The upper panel compares actual jobs waiting with one-hour-ahead lag regression forecasts over four days. The lower panel shows mean absolute error of 2.27 jobs for the last-value baseline and 1.85 jobs for lag regression.
